payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute rightmost positions for each suffix of t in s; then scan s with a left pointer, dynamically updating the right bound based on already matched prefix of t, maximizing the deletion length.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a standard greedy strategy: for each possible left deletion point, it uses precomputed rightmost suffix matches to determine the largest right deletion point. This is a classic two-pointer greedy approach.
